data.title: Micron (MU) Is Getting A New China AI Demand Signal From Kimi K3
data.description: Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3 launch in China drew such heavy usage that the service quickly stopped taking new users. Analysts are pointing to the surge in demand for Chinese AI models as a potential tailwind for memory suppliers like Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU). The user cap at Kimi K3 highlights a tight balance between AI compute needs and available high performance memory supply.
